    yall - package yall
    Yet Another Localization Library: one camera API for PhotonVision, Limelight and Synapse, with PhotonVision simulation for all three, pose filtering, and every camera's estimates ready for a WPILib pose estimator.

    VisionCamera wrappers for PhotonVision, Limelight and Synapse cameras.
    yall.filter - package yall.filter
    Filtering and weighting of vision pose estimates.
    yall.results - package yall.results
    Vendor-neutral camera results: frames, targets and robot pose estimates.
    yall.sim - package yall.sim
    Simulation for every YALL camera, built on PhotonVision's camera simulation.
    yall.telemetry - package yall.telemetry
    What cameras publish to NetworkTables.
